copy.lead: Vibrant and textured, balancing citrus, tropical fruit, minerality, and freshness with a style reminiscent of the great white wines of Bordeaux and Friuli.
copy.notes: Ripe citrus, white peach, and guava open into subtle notes of lemongrass and fresh herbs. The palate is generous but balanced, with bright acidity, a smooth texture, and a clean, refreshing finish.
copy.winemaking: Picked 9/5/25 and taken direct to press, then cold settled and racked off the gross lees. Fermented cold in stainless steel (55–60°F) with a partial, natural malolactic fermentation. Barreled down 10/27/25 into 100% neutral French oak, then racked, sterile filtered, and bottled with high, natural dissolved CO2.

seo.title: 2023 Sauvignon Blanc · Santi Rosina
seo.description: 2023 Sauvignon Blanc from Happy Canyon of Santa Barbara. Vibrant and textured, balancing citrus, tropical fruit, minerality, and freshness with a style reminiscent of the great white wines of Bordeaux and Friuli.

copy.lead: Powerful yet refined, with layered dark fruit, graphite, and polished tannins that speak to the pedigree of the vineyard site.
copy.notes: Fresh blackberry and blackcurrant with graphite, tobacco leaf, and wild herbs. Medium-bodied and precise, the palate shows polished tannins, good acidity, and a cool, lingering finish.
copy.winemaking: Picked 10/9/24 and fermented in a 1.5-ton open-top bin with twice-daily punch downs (0% whole cluster). Drained and pressed 11/6/24, then barreled down 12/11/24 into 25% new French barriques for a natural, slow secondary fermentation.
